description: A governed code change on the main line (a commit checked, reviewed and voted on by members). The changes, newest first: by state, an organization's line (code_distribution), or the main-line changes carrying a line's change upstream. Public.

code_distribution.description: An organization's line (its slug): its changes

state.description: Only changes in this state (proposed, accepted, balloting, passed, merged, failed, withdrawn ...)

upstream.description: Only the main-line changes that carry a line's change upstream

name: theprotocol_listCodeChanges
